lessonRef.subject: financial-literacy
lessonRef.title: Application or project: spotting an ad

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Financial Literacy elementary sequence — Grade 3
Manuel Academy Financial Literacy G3 Unit 5 — money tools, privacy, and advertising
objective: Learners compare an advertised weekly payment plan against a single invented price and find which way of paying costs more in total.
scenario: Bea is an invented third grader who sees a made-up advertisement for a craft kit: pay only $2.00 a week for 5 weeks. The same kit sits on the shelf with an $8.50 price tag. All prices are invented for practice.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Work out what the advertised weekly plan adds up to across all 5 weeks.

prompts.text: What does the $2.00-a-week plan cost Bea in total?

tasks.directions: Set the finished plan total beside the $8.50 shelf tag for the very same kit.

prompts.text: How much more does the weekly plan cost than the shelf price?
Which way of paying costs Bea less overall?

tasks.directions: A second invented advertisement offers the same kit at $1.50 a week for 5 weeks.

prompts.text: What does the second plan cost in total?
How much less is that than the $8.50 shelf price?

tasks.directions: One weekly plan cost more than the tag and one cost less.

prompts.text: Both advertisements showed a small weekly number. What does Bea have to do before she can tell which is cheaper?

remediation: If a learner compares $2.00 with $8.50 directly, lay five weekly cards in a row for Bea and total them aloud before the shelf tag is turned face up.
extension: Ask the learner what weekly amount over five weeks would exactly match the $8.50 shelf price, and how they know.
